items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Because he lived just about a block from us. He was raised up from us. Just about a block from us. They were all raised up together. We all went to school together. He went to school with us.

ctx.x: The other musicians say that. Yeah. That he learned from Bunk.

Bunk Jones. Bunk Jones was the father of those guys. He comes to music. So many of them, I can't recall right now exactly that band. He played music with Bunk Jones. He was a fine player. A good mixer. He was very charming, too. He was a fellow who gave his heart out to everybody else and leave himself in the morning. He really did that. He used to give away all he made.
